meta.title: Weissflug — Flights and hotels, without the surprises
meta.description: Compare flights and hotels across suppliers in one search. The price shown includes taxes, and you see the refund before you cancel.

home.eyebrow: Compare, book and manage in one place
home.title: No surprises at checkout — or afterwards
home.subtitle: We compare flights and hotels across several suppliers in one search. The price shown includes taxes, we re-confirm it with the supplier before you pay, and if your plans change we tell you what comes back before anything is cancelled.

trust.priceTitle: The final price, from the first screen
trust.priceBody: Every price includes taxes and fees — nothing is added at the last step. Before you pay we re-confirm it with the supplier, and if it has moved we say so and wait for your answer.
trust.refundTitle: See the refund before you cancel
trust.refundBody: Plans change. Your bookings page shows exactly what comes back, and any fee, before anything is cancelled — not after, when it is too late to decide differently.
trust.bookedBody: No hand-off to another site at the last step. We issue the ticket, so cancelling, refunding and asking a question all run through us rather than a stranger's support queue.

status.stageNotice: Live search is wired up in the next stage. The interface and design system are in place now.

footer.tagline: Flights and hotels, booked start to finish.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may have changed, or a character is missing. Head back to the homepage and start your search there.

policy.body: The final text for this page is under legal review and lands before launch. If you need details now, get in touch and we will answer directly.

auth.signInSubtitle: Pick up where you left off, and keep your bookings in one place.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Save traveller details once, and book faster every time after.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
auth.resetSubtitle: Make it at least 10 characters. Length matters more than symbols.
auth.name: Full name
auth.verificationSentTo: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. It is good for 24 hours.
auth.resetLinkSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.
auth.passwordResetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with it now.
auth.emailVerified: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
auth.errorInvalid: That email and password do not match an account.
auth.errorLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
auth.errorBlocked: This account has been suspended. Contact us if you think that is a mistake.
auth.errorUnverified: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link we sent.
auth.errorInvalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
auth.signUpFailed: We could not create the account. Check the fields and try again.
auth.networkError: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.resetFailed: We could not change your password. Request a new link and try again.
auth.resetLinkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.
auth.resetLinkMissing: This link is missing its token. Request a new one.
auth.verifyLinkExpired: This confirmation link has expired. Sign up again to get a new one.
auth.verifyLinkInvalid: This confirmation link is not valid.

account.noBookingsBody: Once search goes live you will be able to book here, and every booking will show up on this page.
account.noTravellersBody: Save passport and date-of-birth details once, and they fill themselves in on every booking after that.
